item.title: Obuse: Hokusai Museum & Chestnut Town — Guide
item.description: Obuse is a charming small town northeast of Nagano City, best known as the place where the great ukiyo-e artist Katsushika Hokusai spent his final years, producing works now displayed at the town’s dedicated Hokusai Museum, including painted ceiling panels for local festival floats. Beyond its artistic heritage, Obuse is famous for chestnuts, with shops selling chestnut sweets and rice, alongside sake breweries and beautifully kept lanes and gardens, making it an ideal spot for a relaxed half-day of walking, art and food.
